as_told.title: Chris's 2007 encounter with big balls of fire

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man, says that in January 2007 he climbed a hill near the Cape Fear River and saw two huge glowing red and orange balls of fire, about 40 feet across, over a field. Elsewhere he calls them a craft, and says that as a licensed commercial pilot he knew right away it was nothing from Fort Bragg, the nearby army base, or any military. He tells it as the start of his experiences, which, if true, would mean something not human appeared to him.
